seoDescription: Custom car stickers printed on laminated outdoor vinyl for bumpers, doors, tailgates and windows. Permanent or removable adhesive, any shape, free proof.
tagline: Laminated vinyl stickers for bumpers, doors, tailgates and glass that survive car washes and summer sun.
quickAnswer: Custom car stickers are printed on laminated outdoor vinyl, white or clear, with a permanent adhesive for long-term branding or a removable one for leased and club cars. They go on bumpers, doors, tailgates, hoods and windows, and hold through car washes, road salt and years of sun. Any shape from 0.5 inch to 24 by 36 inches, from $0.30 per sticker, 100 minimum, 5 to 7 business days production.
highlights: Material: laminated white or clear vinyl

sections.h2: Bumpers, doors, tailgates and glass: what this page covers
sections.html:
A car is the hardest place a sticker can live. It bakes on a parking lot at 140°F, gets hit with brushes and 1,200 psi water every other week, and sits in road salt all winter. So every car sticker we print starts with outdoor vinyl, a gloss or matte laminate over the ink, and an adhesive that keeps its grip on factory paint and glass. This page is the general car sticker product: bumper stickers, rectangular and oval window decals, door and tailgate logos, hood stripes, club and dealer stickers and fleet markings, in any shape or size.

The nearest sibling is our die cut car sticker, which is the same vinyl trimmed tightly to the outline of the artwork, with no background, so a logo or a mascot sits on the paint as if it were painted on. If you want that contour-cut look, the die cut car sticker page is the one to order from. If you want a classic rectangle or oval, a printed background, a window panel or a long run of fleet decals with unit numbers, stay here.

sections.html:

Matte laminate hides fine scratches and looks right on a matte wrap or a work truck; gloss matches factory clear coat and makes colors deeper. For trucks, trailers and service vans that work after dark, our custom reflective sticker page covers the reflective film in detail.

sections.h2: Car sticker design that reads from the next lane
sections.html:
A sticker on a moving car has about two seconds to be read, usually from 15 to 40 feet, so the rules are different from a laptop sticker. Our designers set artwork up free of charge, and these are the things they check on every car job:

  • Letter height: one inch of height per ten feet of reading distance. A phone number for the freeway needs 3 to 4 inch digits.
  • Three lines maximum: name, what you do, one way to reach you. Everything else goes on the website.
  • Contrast: dark text on a light background or the reverse. Mid-tone text on a mid-tone car vanishes.
  • No QR codes on the body: nobody scans a moving car. On a parked fleet van a 2 inch code at eye level on the rear door works.
  • Bleed and margins: 0.125 inch of bleed beyond the cut and 0.25 inch of safe margin inside it, or the trim can clip a letter.
  • Vector artwork: AI, EPS, SVG or PDF scales to a 24 inch tailgate without going soft; a 300 dpi JPG at final size is the fallback.

Vehicle stickers sit alongside window, equipment and sign stickers in our usage-based sticker categories, which is a quicker way to find the right build than browsing by material.

sections.h2: Applying a car sticker to paint and glass
sections.html:
Factory paint and glass are two of the easiest surfaces for vinyl, as long as the prep is done. Work in a garage or shade with the panel between 50°F and 90°F to the touch.

  1. Wash the panel, then wipe it with isopropyl alcohol to lift wax, polish and road film. Wax is the main reason car stickers lift early.
  2. Hold the sticker in place with its backing on and mark the corners with masking tape.
  3. Peel back a third of the backing, line up the marked edge and press it down.
  4. Pull the remaining backing out from underneath while pressing the sticker down with a felt squeegee or a credit card wrapped in a cloth, working from the fixed edge outward.
  5. Press the edges hard, and warm the sticker gently with a hair dryer if it crosses a body line or a gentle curve.
  6. Leave it 24 hours before rain and 72 hours before a car wash.

On a window, apply to the outside unless you ordered a reverse-printed inside decal, and keep stickers off the driver's field of view and the rear-view sweep where state laws restrict them.

sections.h2: Car washes, sun, road salt and taking it off later
sections.html:
Once cured, a laminated car sticker goes through brush and touchless washes without complaint; the only thing to avoid is a pressure wand aimed at the edge from closer than a foot. Sun is the slow killer, and a sticker on a hood or roof fades a year or two sooner than one on a door. Road salt, bugs and gas splashes wipe off the laminate without staining it.

Removal is a question to settle before ordering. Permanent adhesive comes off factory paint with heat and patience, with a little residue that rubbing alcohol clears, but it is built to stay. Removable adhesive peels from paint and glass clean after years outside, so it is the one to choose for leased cars, rental fleets and anything you plan to sell. Films beyond vinyl, such as the holographic and metallic stocks listed on the Die Cut Stickers home page, look good on a show car but are not rated for daily road use.

sections.h2: Ordering for one car, a club or a fleet
sections.html:
Prices start at $0.30 per sticker and depend on size, quantity and material, with the minimum at 100 stickers per design. A car club or a dealer giveaway hits that with one design; a fleet usually orders a set of sizes of the same logo, which count together toward the minimum, plus unit numbers as a separate line. Send your artwork or a rough idea, and a free digital proof comes back with the cut line and the adhesive noted. Production takes 5 to 7 business days after approval, delivery lands inside 8 to 10 business days, and FedEx shipping within the United States is free. Rush runs are available for a show or a launch date.

Businesses that brand their vans usually brand their boxes too, and the same artwork files and Pantone references carry straight over to our custom packaging label range, so the truck and the product match.

faqs.q: What material are custom car stickers printed on?
faqs.a: Outdoor-grade vinyl, 3 mil for body panels and 4 mil for bumpers, printed in full color and sealed under a gloss or matte laminate. Clear vinyl with a white ink layer is used on windows, and reflective vinyl for fleet markings. Paper and unlaminated film are never used on a vehicle.

faqs.q: Where on a car should a sticker go to be seen most?
faqs.a: The rear of the vehicle, since that is what the driver behind you stares at in traffic. The tailgate or trunk lid at bumper-to-window height is the prime spot, then the rear window, then the rear quarter panels. Side doors get read in parking lots, so they suit a larger logo and a phone number.

faqs.q: Can custom car decals be printed to read correctly from inside the rear window?
faqs.a: Yes. We reverse print the artwork on clear vinyl with the white ink layer on top, so you apply it to the inside of the glass and it reads correctly from outside. Inside-glass decals are protected from scrapers, weather and car washes and are the longest-lasting option on a vehicle.

faqs.q: How large should text be on a car sticker to read from the next lane?
faqs.a: Plan on one inch of letter height for every ten feet of distance. A car in the next lane is 10 to 15 feet away, so 1.5 inch letters work, while a phone number meant for the car behind you on the freeway needs 3 to 4 inch digits in a bold weight.

faqs.q: Will custom made stickers for cars come off a leased vehicle at return?
faqs.a: Yes, if you order removable adhesive. It holds through years of weather and car washes and still peels from factory paint and glass without residue. Warm the sticker with a hair dryer, lift a corner and pull slowly at a low angle. Permanent adhesive can be removed too, but expect to use alcohol on the residue.

faqs.q: Can I put a car sticker on a plastic bumper?
faqs.a: Yes. Painted bumper covers take vinyl the same as a steel door. Unpainted textured black plastic is the problem: the adhesive grabs only the high points and the sticker lifts within weeks, so keep stickers on the painted areas. Order the 4 mil build for bumpers, since they take the most scrapes and pressure washing.

faqs.q: How do I get help with car sticker design if I only have a rough idea?
faqs.a: Send what you have, even a photo of the car, your logo and the text you want, and our design team lays it out at no charge. You get a digital proof scaled to the panel size with the cut line shown, and revisions are free until it is right. Vector logos give the cleanest result.

faqs.q: Can a car sticker be printed on clear vinyl so only the logo shows?
faqs.a: Yes. Clear vinyl is the standard choice for windows, where the glass shows through around the artwork, and it works on light paint too. A white ink layer is printed behind the colors so they stay solid rather than tinted by the surface. On dark paint, white vinyl trimmed to the logo looks cleaner.

faqs.q: How soon after applying a car sticker can I wash the car?
faqs.a: Wait 24 hours before rain or a hand wash and 72 hours before an automatic car wash. The adhesive needs that time to flow into the surface and reach full strength. After that, brush and touchless washes are fine; just keep a pressure wand at least a foot from the sticker edges.

faqs.q: Will heat inside a parked car loosen a window sticker?
faqs.a: No. The vinyl and adhesive are rated to 176°F in service, which is above what a closed car reaches in a Phoenix parking lot. Heat matters only during application, when a panel hotter than 90°F makes the adhesive grab before you can position the sticker, so apply in shade or a garage.

faqs.q: How many custom car stickers do I have to order for one vehicle?
faqs.a: The minimum is 100 stickers per design, from $0.30 each depending on size, quantity and material. One car rarely needs 100, so most single-vehicle buyers order a design they can also hand out, use on a trailer or sell to club members. Several sizes of the same logo count together toward the minimum.

faqs.q: Can custom car stickers be rushed for a car show date?
faqs.a: Yes. Standard production is 5 to 7 business days after you approve the proof, with delivery inside 8 to 10 business days. Give us the show date on the quote request and we schedule rush production to meet it. Approving the proof the same day it arrives is the biggest time saver on your side.
